div.div: Wikipedian's are commissioned by their local community to put their local event onto a vernacular platform
To encourage language communities to share their spaces and practices with others language communities
Completion of a performance task that involves a knowledge graph (map, family, book etc)
Mapmakers then become move onto another knowledge graph.
